Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap. Quick clarifications from our side so we can scope internally: 

- SOC 2: are you SOC 2 Type II certified? If so, can you share the latest report (redacted where necessary)?
- Deletion SLA: For application-level deletion we typically expect 30 days max; for backups we need to understand your restore window and whether you can purge customer data from backups within 90 days or negotiate a retention carve-out.
- Logs: what is your default audit/log retention (e.g., 90/180/365 days)? Do you offer configurable log retention per customer?
- HIPAA: Amaya has a PHI scope for a subset of our workflows — can you confirm whether Redwood will sign a BAA and what controls are in place for PHI?

Also, please start the vendor security questionnaire — I've attached our standard questionnaire link in a separate email to our security alias, but if you want I can drop the doc in DocuSign for review. Our security team would prefer to have the SOC 2 and the retention matrix before a full questionnaire review.

If you can share the SOC 2 and a short table outlining the deletion timelines and backup retention, that would be ideal. Thanks —

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up: data retention & deletion SLAs / SOC 2 questions (deal AMY-2026-089)

Hi all — thanks for the context. Short answers below and I've attached the SOC 2 report and the retention matrix for Amaya's review.

- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II certified (report attached: SOC2-report-Redwood-Inference-2025.pdf). We share a redacted report for sales/procurement; full or more detailed evidence can be provided under an NDA if needed.

- GDPR / DPA: We have a standard DPA and data processing addendum. We support data subject rights workflows and can map data stores for deletion requests.

- Deletion SLA (standard):
  • Application-level deletion: irreversible deletion from primary storage within 30 days of request (typically completes within 24-72 hours depending on job queue).
  • Backups: rolling backups retained for 90 days by default. We offer an enterprise contract option to schedule expedited purge from backups within a negotiated SLA (commonly 60-90 days). Full single-tenant/private deployments can have custom backup retention configured.

- Logs / Audit trails:
  • Default audit/log retention: 365 days.
  • We can offer configurable retention windows (90/180/365) for enterprise customers via configuration or contract. Long-term archival beyond 365 days is available as a paid add-on.

- HIPAA / BAA: We will sign a BAA for customers with PHI scope. Additional technical controls (encryption at rest/in transit, SOC 2 controls map, access reviews, KMS/HSM integration) are standard; we can provide a controls matrix specific to HIPAA requests.

Attachments included for Amaya:
- SOC2-report-Redwood-Inference-2025.pdf (redacted)
- data-retention-matrix.csv (application, backup, log retention rows)

If Amaya wants the vendor questionnaire completed, please send the doc or a link and we'll have our security program owner complete it (typical turnaround 3-5 business days). Happy to hop on a joint call to walk through the retention matrix and any carve-outs for backups.

Regards,

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
